goal: Make the pass-2 supersession repair replay a later applied routine drop unconditionally when no applied migration at or after the dropping file re-declares that routine, so the between-pass baseline cannot defeat the drop guard.
assumptions: The captured pre-adoption baseline loads between pass 1 and pass 2 and can re-create a routine a pass-1 migration dropped.
The workflow already executes every row the script's snapshot query returns after the pass-2 migration, so no workflow change is needed.
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, claim, lease, or infrastructure write.
Do not weaken, skip or quarantine any contract test.
Do not replay a drop from a later migration that is not proven applied in the replay.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix requires changing the contract-test workflow, the baseline, or any file outside the script, its test and the evidence pair.
